definitions: An act of falling or dropping from a higher to a lower place.
The amount or distance through which something falls.
A sudden drop in amount, quantity, or intensity.
A long, loose scarf, typically of lace, worn by women over the head and shoulders.
A wrestling move in which one combatant throws the other to the ground.
The part of a rope that hangs free or is used for pulling.
examples: He broke his arm in a fall.
The leaves change colour in the fall.
She wore a black lace fall.
He won by a fall in the second round.
Pull on the fall to raise the sail.
